# Goel Astro

> Vedic astrology (jyotish) consultation service based in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India. Consultations are online: book on the website, pay by UPI, and receive a written report on WhatsApp in Hindi or English, usually within 24 hours (24-48 hours for kundli milan). Open 10 AM to 8 PM, all days.

## Services and prices (INR)

- [Kundli analysis](https://goelastro.com/kundli-analysis): 1-year prediction ₹1,000; full 3-year analysis ₹2,100
- [Janam kundli](https://goelastro.com/janam-kundli): black & white ₹1,000; coloured ₹1,500
- [Kundli milan](https://goelastro.com/kundli-milan): Ashtakoot gun milan report for marriage ₹500
- [Career astrology](https://goelastro.com/career-astrology): career guidance ₹750
- [Gemstone consultation](https://goelastro.com/gemstone-consultation): ₹300

## Booking and contact
